plan: Log in to SupplyHub and retrieve all invoices for Globex Industries.
Identify the invoice with the most recent invoice date and extract the invoice number, total payable, and due date.
Log in to Acme ERP and verify Globex Industries exists in the vendor master.
Search Acme ERP Accounts Payable to verify that this invoice number is not already recorded.
Format the extracted values: due date as DD-MM-YYYY, amount as plain number, category as 'Raw Materials', and notes as 'Recorded by AI operator from SupplyHub'.
Evaluate whether the invoice amount is >= INR 50,000 and seek manager approval prior to submission if threshold is met.
Create and submit the AP invoice record in Acme ERP.
Confirm completion and report invoice details back to the requester.
relevant_policies: Latest invoice definition: invoice with the most recent invoice date on SupplyHub (not highest number or first row).
Duplicate check: check AP list first - never record an invoice that is already recorded.
Data formatting: invoice number exact match; amount as plain number without commas/currency symbols; due date as DD-MM-YYYY.
Expense category: Globex Industries maps to 'Raw Materials'.
Notes: must read 'Recorded by AI operator from SupplyHub'.
Vendor master check: supplier must already exist in ERP vendor master; do not create vendor without procurement onboarding request.
Approval threshold: any AP invoice with amount >= INR 50,000 requires manager approval before submission.
risks: Invoice amount equals or exceeds INR 50,000, requiring manager approval before submission.
Invoice has already been recorded in AP, which must halt processing to avoid double payment.
Globex Industries does not exist in the ERP vendor master, requiring escalation instead of creation.
Date format or amount format discrepancies between SupplyHub display and ERP input requirements.
